overview_description.description:
Avo creates one source of truth for analytics events and generates personalized tracking libraries that give developers dev time validation that implementation is correct. 

Avo is a toolbox (UI and dev tool) to define event based analytics, and generate personalized tracking libraries that provide dev time validation of correct implementation. It's like a spell-checker for people to define quality data, and a type-checker for developers to make sure they send analytics according to design.

about_short_description.short_description: Avo is a leading data quality platform for product analytics. Adobe, Fender & Ikea use Avo to plan, implement & verify data 10x faster.

product.name: Avo Analytics Governance Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for designing, implementing, validating, and monitoring product analytics data across teams, applications, analytics tools, and data pipelines.

product.name: Avo Tracking Plan
product.description: A shared workspace for defining and governing analytics events, properties, naming conventions, ownership, and implementation requirements across products and teams.

product.name: Avo Inspector
product.description: An observability product that analyzes event metadata to identify tracking inconsistencies, missing properties, schema drift, and other product analytics data-quality issues.

product.name: Avo Implementation Tools
product.description: Developer tools for deploying analytics tracking from governed schemas using generated instructions, code snippets, type-safe wrappers, and implementation validation.

product.name: Avo Integrations and Publishing
product.description: Connectors and publishing capabilities that synchronize Avo tracking plans with analytics platforms, customer data platforms, pipelines, schema registries, and collaboration tools.
